verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's open.gsa.gov docs give static parameter examples (e.g. ueiSAM=RV56IG5JM6G9) and a sample request URL. Users can run GET calls in a browser or Postman with an API key, and a downloadable OpenAPI spec could be imported into such a client. There is no evidence of an interactive in-page reference or try-it console, so runnability depends on external tools. The probe 404s at standard OpenAPI paths only show the spec isn't at well-known locations, not that it's absent. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it/explorer API reference, in-page runnable examples, discoverable machine-readable spec paths, independent hands-on corroboration.
